faq.q: Is there a median price for Mission lots and land?
faq.a: Not in the permitted source: SnapStats publishes no land-only split — its Mission figures cover dwellings only (September 2026 detached median $814,000 on 231 listings; Condos & Townhomes median $430,000 on 122 listings) — so no land count, share or median is stated here, and a lot must be priced on comparable lot sales, not on dwelling medians (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: What can I build on ALR land near Mission?
faq.a: The ALC frame permits one principal residence of at most 500 m², a secondary suite only if it is entirely contained within that principal residence and local bylaws allow suites, and at most one additional detached residence of 90 m² (parcels ≤40 ha) or 186 m² (parcels >40 ha); local governments may further restrict residences through zoning.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home in Mission Lots & Land is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
